**Here are the 5 most notable recent tweets** (from Aug 2026 searches focused on Apex Fusion Vector launch and related AI-agent escrow/jury/dispute themes):

- **@CardanoFeed** (Aug 18): Straightforward announcement that Apex Fusion has opened its settlement layer for AI agents, linking to coverage of the staked-jury, bonded-escrow system on Cardano eUTXO.[[1]](https://x.com/CardanoFeed/status/2089644319070110063)

- **@Aces1974** (Jerry Fragiskatos, Apex Fusion founder, Aug 18): In-depth thread-style post detailing Vector’s launch as a neutral on-chain settlement, accountability, and provenance layer—covering staked reputation, bonded escrow, staked-jury dispute resolution, signed receipts, OriginTrail DKG integration, and live dashboard/agent registration.[[2]](https://x.com/Aces1974/status/2089763876460236822)

- **@APEXFusion23** (Aug 18): Technical comparison post explaining Vector’s architecture (Prime Ouroboros root + Vector eUTxO execution layer) vs. EigenCloud, highlighting non-transferable identities, bonded escrow, signed receipts, staked juries, deterministic fees, and no MEV/shared-state issues for agent-to-agent work.[[3]](https://x.com/APEXFusion23/status/2089701079302754348)

- **@RealSaidov** (Aug 19): Noted that Apex Fusion’s Vector already enables agent wallets/settlement on Cardano, contrasting it with Charles Hoskinson’s timeline for “agentic trading” later in the year.[[4]](https://x.com/RealSaidov/status/2090125523644977529)

- **@AIEconomicsUS** (Aug 19): Highlighted Vector as adding a bonded-escrow settlement layer for AI agents and proposed a similar “AgentTrust” system for automated cross-org tasks with verifiable audits.[[5]](https://x.com/AIEconomicsUS/status/2090121123304239322)

**General AI-judged escrow/jury chatter** was lighter but clustered around projects like Yellow (escrow + verified outcomes for agent commerce) and @courtofinternet / GenLayer (decentralized AI jury for disputes, often tied to escrow and evidence). No major competing launches matched Vector’s specific staked-jury + Cardano timing.
